zb eval --expression 'path("hello.txt")'
stdout ^$ZB_STORE_DIR${/}

read storePath
zb store object info $storePath
stdout ^StorePath:\s+$storePath$
stdout '^NarHash:\s+sha256:0xmvxmsmmc6n79sk2h3r6db3yp8drmxps61mdk7iqnvc6vcsww60$'
stdout '^NarSize:\s+128$'
stdout '^CA:\s+fixed:r:sha256:[0-9a-z]+$'

-- hello.txt --
Hello, World!
